transcript.answer:
http://127.0.0.1:8765/solarium_b.html and summarize what the Solarium Project is.


  The Solarium Project is a grid-scale solar-battery pilot founded in 2019 and located
  in
  Nevada. It pairs a photovoltaic array with 42 MWh of battery storage to smooth evening
  demand for the regional grid.

  The project is expanding: it plans to increase storage capacity to 90 MWh by 2027,
  which includes adding a second site in Arizona. Both sites will share the same control
  software and interconnect design. Permitting for the Arizona site is currently
  underway, with construction milestones to be posted as they're reached. The project
  publishes quarterly performance summaries.
